title: The interior crack structure of fidelity Mumford–Shah absolute minimizers
exact_target: For a reduced absolute minimizer (u,K) of $integral_(Omega$ minus K)|grad $u|^2$ + $integral_Omega|u-g|^2$ + $H^1(K)$ in a bounded planar Lipschitz domain with bounded datum g, must every interior crack point locally lie on a single $C^{1,\alpha }$ arc, a terminal $C^{1,\alpha }$ arc, or a triple of such arcs meeting at 120 degrees? Require only finitely many global crack components to meet each relatively compact interior open set.
